methods.name: analysis.create
methods.summary: Create and start an analysis by module name and analysis name.

params.name: analysis
params.description: Analysis name within the module, e.g. 'TTestIndependent'.

status.description: Always 'success' when the analysis was created.

analysisId.description: Unique integer identifier for the new analysis.

methods.name: analysis.setOptions
methods.summary: Set analysis options for an existing analysis by ID.

params.name: analysisId
params.description: The integer identifier of the analysis to modify.

params.name: options
params.description: An object of option name/value pairs to set on the analysis.

result.name: analysis.setOptions.result
result.description: Confirmation that the options were applied, or an error if any options failed validation.

status.description: 'success' when the options were applied, or 'error' if one or more options failed validation.

message.description: When status is 'error', a description of the validation failures, with control names and reasons.

methods.name: analysis.getOptions
methods.summary: Retrieve the current analysis options by analysis ID.

params.name: analysisId
params.description: The integer identifier of the analysis to query.

result.name: analysis.getOptions.result
result.description: The current options of the analysis.

status.description: Always 'success' when the options were retrieved.

methods.name: analysis.results
methods.summary: Retrieve the current results of an analysis by ID.

params.name: analysisId
params.description: The integer identifier of the analysis to query.

result.name: analysis.results.result
result.description: The current results of the analysis.

results.description: The full results JSON of the analysis, or null if not yet available.

methods.name: analysis.status
methods.summary: Query the run status of an analysis by ID.

params.name: analysisId
params.description: The integer identifier of the analysis to query.

result.name: analysis.status.result
result.description: The current run status of the analysis.

analysisStatus.description: The analysis run status, e.g. 'running', 'complete', 'fatalError'. Note: 'empty' is reported as 'running'.

methods.name: analysis.context
methods.summary: Retrieve context for an analysis: QML form file(s), help text, or other analysis metadata. Intended for AI clients that need to understand what options are available and how to set them.

params.name: analysis
params.description: Analysis name within the module, e.g. 'TTestIndependentSamples'.

result.name: analysis.context.result
result.description: The QML source of the analysis form and any locally imported QML files. Each entry in 'files' maps a relative path to its QML source text.

files.description: Map of relative file path to QML source text. Always contains the main form file; may include locally imported QML files.

help.description: The analysis help text in Markdown format, or empty string if no help file exists for this analysis.

methods.name: modules.list
methods.summary: List all loaded modules and their available analyses.

title.description: Human-readable analysis title, e.g. 'Independent Samples T-Test'.

methods.name: data.load
methods.summary: Load a data file into the workspace.

params.name: path
params.description: Absolute path to the data file (CSV, SPSS, JASP, Excel, etc.).

type.description: Column type: unknown, scale, ordinal, nominal, or nominalText.

methods.name: data.load.async
methods.summary: Start loading a data file asynchronously. Returns a jobId immediately.

params.name: path
params.description: Absolute path to the data file (CSV, SPSS, JASP, Excel, etc.).

jobId.description: Unique job identifier for polling with data.load.status.

methods.name: data.load.status
methods.summary: Poll the status of an async data load job.

params.name: jobId
params.description: The job identifier returned by data.load.async.

result.name: data.load.status.result
result.description: Current status of the async load job.

message.description: Error message, present when status is 'error'. Use data.info to retrieve dataset metadata when status is 'complete'.

methods.name: data.info
methods.summary: Retrieve metadata about the currently loaded dataset.

result.name: data.info.result
result.description: Metadata about the loaded dataset, or loaded=false if none.

loaded.description: Whether a dataset is currently loaded.

path.description: Path to the currently loaded file.

methods.name: ping
methods.summary: Simple connectivity check. Always returns pong.

methods.name: rpc.discover
methods.summary: Schema discovery. Returns the names of all registered RPC methods.

methods.description: List of registered method name strings.
